description: Transvaalbuurt 1931 portiek rows of Schalk Burgerstraat 59-77 and 99-115: 6.7-6.8 m stair-block pands of five storeys in a grey-brown brick laid in a diaper (a lattice of lighter headers over the whole wall), a 3.45 m ground storey, three 2.95 m storeys and a 3.2 m top storey with small windows under light hoods; a pair of white two-light casements and, on the axis against one party wall, a shallow box window with glazed returns (a corner window) on storeys 1-3 over the portiek door, which shares a flat canopy with its mirrored neighbour's; a flat roof run out as a light eaves slab at 15.0-15.45 m This twin is the pand whose oriel and portiek door stand at its left party wall: the BAG cut between two pands sharing a portiek lies about 1 m left of the portiek axis, so the left-hand pand is not a mirror of the right-hand one (oriel 0.6 m from its left wall, the pair at 3.1 and 4.8 m)

match.note: Schalk Burgerstraat 45-131 (BAG 1931 on all 9 pands) on the 2020-04-30 strip, gridded 1 m: six 6.7-6.8 m stair-block pands of this front (59-77, 99-115); the 19.9 m centre pand 79-97 (a raised centre over a round-arched gateway, windows in a different rhythm) and the end pands 45-57 (10.6 m, 3DBAG eaves 10.4 m: a corner wing) and 117-131 (11.3 m, a corner with balconies) are other fronts and fall outside the width range. 3DBAG eaves 14.9 m; the eaves slab on the strip 15.0-15.45 m (frontEavesM). Axis pitch 1.4-3.2 m: three columns over 6.8 m. Twin: Schalk Burgerstraat 65, 99, 111 (2020-04-30 strip gridded 1 m: oriel centre 0.6 m, pair 3.1 and 4.8 m, attic windows 0.7, 2.9, 5.1 m from the pand left); the mirrored base type put the pair 0.9 m right of the photo. Placed by review pin only. Wall: match.measuredWall false, one brick for the row: #585553 fitted through the city tint (fit-wall-palette fitWallBrick: drawn #6e5957 of #5b5352 -> photo median #695f5c of the six tree-free pand walls 59-111), drawn #6d5f57.

flat-slab.note: Schalk Burgerstraat 59-77 (140152 076994 093454): a light grey eaves slab 15.0-15.45 m (raw #acadaf), flat roof

door-left.note: the teal portiek door on the oriel axis at the left party wall under the flat grey canopy shared with the left neighbour; ground windows under the pair

roof.evidence: Schalk Burgerstraat 59-115 strip 2020-04-30: blue sky directly over the eaves slab, no roof face; 3DBAG roof max 14.9 m = eaves
